description: Maintain a clean and professional look with Rothco’s Black Genuine Cowhide Garrison Belt. This black leather dress belt is great for first responders, public safety, and civilians. Made from high-quality top-grain leather, this sturdy duty belt is designed to support a partial first responder loadout and withstand daily wear for years. The uniform belt features 2 snaps near the interchangeable nickel-plated belt buckle, allowing for easy customization. Simply open the snaps, slide the buckle off, and replace it with a buckle of your choosing. With 5 holes spaced 1 inch apart, you can easily find the perfect fit. Available in 1.25 inch and 1.75 inch widths, this leather duty belt accommodates most belt loop sizes, making it a versatile addition to your wardrobe.
